chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Muskan, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, concerning the salat of the two Eids, who said:
Say six takbirs and perform ruku' with the seventh. Then stand in the second rak'ah and recite, then say four takbirs and perform ruku' with the fifth.

key_terms.الثَّانِيَةِ: the second rak'ah of the prayer
key_terms.السَّابِعَةِ: the seventh takbir, upon which ruku' is performed in the first rak'ah
key_terms.الْخَامِسَةِ: the fifth takbir, upon which ruku' is performed in the second rak'ah
key_terms.تَكْبِيرَاتٍ: repetitions of takbir within the prayer
key_terms.صَلَاةِ الْعِيدَيْنِ: the salat of Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha
key_terms.فَاقْرَأْ: recite the designated recitation in prayer
key_terms.كَبِّرْ: say the takbir, declaring Allah's greatness

ai.seo_question: How are the takbirs performed in salat of Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the manner of takbir in salat of the two Eids. It states that in the first rak'ah six takbirs are said before ruku', making ruku' on the seventh, and in the second rak'ah four takbirs are said before ruku', making ruku' on the fifth.
